history.summary: A 958 sqft 2BR at Simei (D18) for $1,130k — a roomy, well-sized 2BR in the deep $1.8M-and-under liquid band, with a strong 7.54% appreciation on 147 txns. The offset is age: built 1998, so the 99LH has only ~71 years left and lease decay is the key risk over the hold.
history.rating_rationale: The 7.54% resale-only CAGR over 147 txns is the highest reliable rate in the batch and the 958 sqft 2BR at $1,179 psf (just under the $1,199.5 median) sits in the deepest-liquidity quantum band — both strongly positive. But the development is 28 years old (TOP 1998) with ~71 years of lease remaining, and over a 5–7yr hold lease decay below 70 years starts to bite on financing and resale. The high historical CAGR partly reflects an old-leasehold rebound off a low base that is not guaranteed to repeat. Strong yield/liquidity vs lease-decay headwind nets to Neutral.
red_flags: Built 1998 — ~71 years lease left, decay accelerates and approaches the 70yr financing threshold during the hold
Old development: higher maintenance, dated facilities
High past CAGR off a low old-leasehold base may not persist as lease shortens
catalysts: Strong 7.54%/yr resale-only appreciation on a reliable 147-txn series
Well-sized 958 sqft 2BR in the deepest-liquidity sub-$1.2M band
Simei EW3 MRT 610m, near Changi Business Park / SUTD tenant demand
